cell_users_password_hash_check.name: cell_users_password_hash_check
cell_users_password_hash_check.value: password_hash IS NULL OR password_hash LIKE '$argon2id$%'

cell_users_totp_enabled_check.name: cell_users_totp_enabled_check
cell_users_totp_enabled_check.value: totp_enabled_at IS NULL OR totp_secret_ciphertext IS NOT NULL

cell_users_totp_pending_check.name: cell_users_totp_pending_check
cell_users_totp_pending_check.value: (totp_pending_secret_ciphertext IS NULL) = (totp_pending_key_id IS NULL) AND (totp_pending_secret_ciphertext IS NULL) = (totp_pending_created_at IS NULL)

products_external_source_unique.name: products_external_source_unique
products_external_source_unique.where: source_system <> 'manual' AND source_external_id IS NOT NULL

contacts_client_cw_contact_unique.name: contacts_client_cw_contact_unique
contacts_client_cw_contact_unique.where: chatwoot_contact_id IS NOT NULL AND deleted_at IS NULL

contacts_client_email_unique.name: contacts_client_email_unique
contacts_client_email_unique.where: email IS NOT NULL AND deleted_at IS NULL

contacts_client_document_unique.name: contacts_client_document_unique
contacts_client_document_unique.where: document_number IS NOT NULL AND deleted_at IS NULL

contacts_document_type_check.name: contacts_document_type_check
contacts_document_type_check.value: document_type IS NULL OR document_type IN ('CC', 'NIT', 'CE', 'PASSPORT', 'other')

orders_cw_conversation_active_unique.name: orders_cw_conversation_active_unique
orders_cw_conversation_active_unique.where: chatwoot_conversation_id IS NOT NULL AND status IN ('registered', 'confirmed')
